name: Montgat (Spain)
description: Dark blue field with the white tower of the arms in the upper hoist and two white wavy stripes along the lower edge.
history: The official flag of Montgat, approved in August 2012, is an oblong flag of 2:3, dark blue, with the white tower of the arms with blue door and windows placed at 6/62 from the upper edge and 5/93 from the hoist, and two white wavy fesses.

features.role: tower with blue door and windows, 20/62 of the height
